title: Sharaab mein fayda? (faceless, one 3D world, ~83 s)

lines.line: Sharaab mein *fayda* hai. Yeh Quran kehta hai.

options.visual: 0.0 s: low camera on a dark walnut table; a big brass balance fills the frame, a green glass bottle sits on its left pan, the beam already swinging. 0.6 s 'fayda': a brass weight marked + drops into the left pan, the beam dips, dust lifts in the key light. 1.5 s: hard cut, the camera is overhead, 'Benefit?' set big in serif beside the pan. 2.4 s 'Quran': whip pan right, a 3D Quran (deep green leather, gold geometric border, القرآن الكريم) lands flat on the table beside the scale. 3.3 s: push in on the gold title as the cover starts to open.
options.sound: sub-hit on frame 0 under the voice, brass clink on the weight, whoosh on the whip, soft book thud
options.why: The whole reel's idea (a scale) is the first picture; the contradiction (alcohol + benefit + Quran) is on screen inside 2.5 s and reads with the sound off.

options.visual: 0.0 s: the 3D Quran already open in close-up, light raking across the page. 0.6 s 'fayda': the word مَنَٰفِعُ lifts off the page in gold. 1.5 s: cut to the bottle on the scale. 2.4 s: back to the book closing to show its cover.
options.why: Starts on the Quran, but the bottle (the surprise) arrives later than 1.5 s.

options.visual: 0.0 s: a bottle spins slowly in a pool of light, 'BENEFIT' written on its label in our type; 1.5 s: the label tears away; 2.4 s: the Quran rises behind it.
options.why: Striking, but a 'product shot' of a bottle can look like an alcohol ad.

lines.line: Haan, sahi suna tumne. Quran ki Surah Baqarah, verse 219.

options.visual: The cover swings open; pages fan past in one fast flip and settle; a small paper tag slides onto the page: Al-Baqarah 2:219.
options.sound: page flutter, paper slide on the tag
options.why: The book itself carries the reference; two beats (open, flip) keep the hook moving.

options.visual: Camera orbits the closed book while '2:219' writes itself in gold on the table.
options.why: Calmer, but one beat only.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (Al-Baqarah 2:219) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: "Inmein badi buraai hai, aur logon ke liye kuch *fayde* bhi hain."

options.visual: Close on the open page: 2:219 words 1–14 in Amiri Quran (fetched). As each half is spoken a hand-drawn ring closes: إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ in rust, then مَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ in brass. The Sahih International line sits below in serif.
options.text: In them is great sin, and some benefit for people.
options.sound: pen circle under each ring; bed out (an Ayah on screen)
options.why: The real words on a real page, the two sides of the scale already coloured.

options.layout: torn paper card over the 3D table
options.visual: The Ayah on a torn paper card floating over the scale.
options.why: The approved chaand-nur card, but the 3D book is the stronger object here.

lines.line: Aur agli hi line mein: "Lekin inki buraai, inke fayde se *badi* hai."

options.visual: The camera slides down the page to وَإِثْمُهُمَآ أَكْبَرُ مِن نَّفْعِهِمَا; on 'badi' the word أَكْبَرُ is ringed in rust and a small brass scale drawn in ink on the page margin tips to the harm side.
options.text: But their sin is greater than their benefit.
options.sound: pen circle, soft brass clink on the tip
options.why: The verdict word gets the ring; the ink scale on the page sets up the 3D scale.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (But their sin is greater than their benefit.) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.text: But their sin is greater than their benefit.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Toh sawaal yeh banta hai ki jab fayda maan liya, toh phir mana kyun kiya.

options.visual: The camera lifts off the book and pulls back over the table: the book on the right, the big scale in the centre, the bottle on its pan. One line lands on the dark wall behind: 'Then why ban it?'
options.sound: low whoosh on the pull back
options.why: The question the whole reel answers, said on the wide shot that shows every player.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (Then why ban it?) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Iske liye ek tarazu imagine karo.

options.visual: The bottle lifts off; both pans empty and level; the camera dollies to a hero angle of the scale, the beam glinting. Two words in the wall's dark at the pans: Benefit (left), Harm (right).
options.why: Resets the scale so the viewer can watch it fill.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (Benefit / Harm) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Ek taraf woh fayde rakho, jo purane Islamic scholars ne khud likhe hain.

options.visual: A sheet from Ibn Kathir's tafsir (quran.com English page, cropped to the benefits sentence) slides across the table under the left pan; the sentence is underlined as spoken.
options.why: A real artifact for 'scholars ne khud likhe'.

options.visual: An old book (no title) opens beside the pan.
options.why: Simpler, but a made-up book.

lines.line: Thodi khushi, thoda maza, aur bechne walon ka *profit*.

options.visual: Three brass weights drop into the left pan on the three words, each with an engraved label: Joy, Pleasure, Profit; on 'profit' a short stack of coins. The beam dips left a little each time.
options.sound: three brass clinks (rotated takes), coin chink on profit
options.why: Three beats, each a real object hitting the scale.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (Joy · Pleasure · Profit) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Ab doosri taraf ka hisaab dekho, jo aaj World Health Organisation deta hai.

options.visual: The camera swings to the right pan. A printed sheet of WHO's 25 June 2024 news release slides onto the table, cropped to its headline and date (WHO forbids its emblem without written permission, so no logo). Credit line names the source in full.
options.tag: Established data · WHO, Global status report on alcohol and health, 2024
options.sound: whoosh on the swing, paper slide
options.why: A real artifact carries the source; the emblem stays off by WHO's rule.

options.visual: The organisation's full name typeset large in our sans on the wall, the year below.
options.why: Cleanest; no artifact.

lines.line: Duniya mein har saal lagbhag *26 lakh* log sirf sharaab ki wajah se mar jaate hain.

options.visual: A heavy iron weight engraved 2.6 million drops into the right pan on '26 lakh'; the beam slams down to the harm side, the left pan's brass weights jump. The number lands big on the wall: 26,00,000 / year.
options.why: The reel's biggest physical moment, on its biggest number.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (26,00,000 deaths a year) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Yaani har roz lagbhag *7 hazaar* log.

options.visual: A desk calendar on the table flips one day; '≈ 7,000' prints on the page as the camera pushes in.
options.why: Turns a yearly number into a day the viewer can picture.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (≈ 7,000 every day) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Lekin dhyaan do, Quran ne mana karte waqt health ki baat ki hi nahi.

options.visual: Camera back to the Quran; the pages turn to Al-Ma'idah; a faint word 'Health' on the wall fades out as the page settles.
options.why: Moves the viewer from data back to the text.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (none) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Usne kaha, isse logon ke beech *dushmani* aur nafrat badhti hai.

options.visual: 5:91 on the page (fetched); ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ ringed in rust, the meaning beside it.
options.why: The Quran's own reason, on its own words.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (enmity and hatred) set in serif on the dark wall.
options.why: Quieter and cheaper to build, but fewer visible changes (QUALITY §2 wants one every 2-4 s).

lines.line: Aur insaan Allah ko, namaz ko bhool jaata hai.

options.visual: Second ring on ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ, the meaning beside it.
options.text: the remembrance of Allah and prayer
options.why: Completes the Quran's stated reason.

options.visual: Same beat with no new object: the camera drifts slowly over the scale or the book and the key words (the remembrance of Allah and prayer) set in serif on the dark wall.

lines.line: Ek Muslim ke liye toh yeh Allah ka hukm hai, data ho ya na ho.

options.visual: The book closes slowly; warm light settles on the gold title; one line on the wall: For a Muslim, it is Allah's command.
options.text: For a Muslim, it is Allah's command.
options.sound: soft book close, room tone only
options.why: Says plainly that the data is not the reason for the ruling.

options.why: Hands the viewer back to the logic.

lines.line: 2022 mein duniya ke bade medical journal, The Lancet, mein ek *badi* study aayi.

options.tag: Established science · GBD 2020 Alcohol Collaborators, The Lancet 2022 (CC BY 4.0)
options.why: The real paper, legally reusable, carries the claim.

options.visual: Back to the scale: a tiny brass weight marked 40+ drops into the benefit pan; the beam barely moves. Word on the wall: maybe.
options.why: The honest nuance made physical: a benefit that hardly moves the beam.

options.why: The age the audience is; the number is the hit.
